description: Upload a file onto a card from a local file path, or from base64 plus a filename. The same limits the REST upload route enforces apply and its errors surface verbatim: 10 MB per file, the workspace storage cap (409 limit_reached), executable extensions refused, and the token creator needs a verified email.

base64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded. Give with filename.

card.description: Card key (e.g. "ZNA-2001") or card id. Both work everywhere a card is addressed.

filename.description: The file's name, extension included (e.g. screenshot.png). Required with base64.

path.description: Local file path to read and upload. Give this, or base64 + filename.

name: zuuna_upload_attachment
title: zuuna_upload_attachment
